articles.summary: Annual grants totaling $624,100 were awarded to nonprofits across seven US states. Forty-nine nonprofits were chosen, including 12 new grantees. Sensata Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Sensata Technologies, has awarded $624,100 in annual grants to 49 charitable organizations across the US, including 12 new grantees. The grants help advance the Foundation’s vision to empower the next generation of engineers and support communities where Sensata employees live and work. Employees volunteer at Franklin Farm, a Sensata Foundation grantee. The awardees are US-based 501(c)(3) charitable entities, chosen from applications submitted earlier this year. Highlights: Grantees are located across California, Idaho, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Rhode Island and Vermont. The Foundation increased grant funding by nearly 16% compared to 2025, with seven more nonprofit organizations receiving grants this year.
